title: Path Control mask ignores configured PCS in Rust/C (fixed full-octet mask)
description: Spec 05-routing.md §8.8 (R-05-062): 'The root MUST mask bits outside the configured PCS + 1 active bits, then compare each candidate's most-preferred active non-empty Path Control subfield in PC1, PC2, PC3, PC4 order. It MUST NOT compare complete Path Control octets or individual bits numerically.' Divergent: Rust rust/lichen-node/src/rpl_stack/routing.rs:1717-1723 path_control_rank masks with fixed PATH_CONTROL_SIZE=7 const (comment: 'LICHEN fixed RPL profile activates all eight Path Control bits (PCS=7)') instead of the PCS value received in the DODAG Configuration option; C uses LICHEN_RPL_PATH_CONTROL_MASK 0xffU (lichen/subsys/lichen/rpl/include/lichen/rpl_routing.h:56) + path_control_priority (rpl_dao_process.c:563-571). Only Python honors configured PCS (python/src/lichen/rpl/dao_paths.py:41-51 path_control_rank masks (0xFF << (7-pcs)) & 0xFF). Subfield ordering and no-active-bit atomic rejection are implemented in all three. Fix: thread the DODAG Config PCS value into Path Control ranking in Rust + C (or document fixed PCS=7 as profile decision and update spec).
